notes: Notion's look: a monochrome black-on-white base with one Notion blue (#097fe8) for primary CTAs; the secondary CTA uses a light-blue fill. In the hero headline, one word sits in a pale-blue pill with a blue dot and looks like a live status chip. Product UI mocks (kanban, database table, AI chart answer, agent chat) are the main imagery, sitting on warm off-white #f9f9f8 panels. Line-drawn black-and-white Notion-style characters peek around the screenshot. Testimonials use monotone color-tinted portrait photos (red/blue/yellow) with serif quotes, which adds an editorial contrast to the sans UI. In the capture, the logo wall rendered over the hero screenshot (a capture artifact; on the live page it sits below). The nav dropdowns open mega-panels with illustrated tiles (seen live). The cookie consent is a fixed bottom-right card (proposal filed for that placement).
